name: Breadcrumbs
description: A framework-free Web Component that styles a native trail of links, keeps the separator out of the accessibility tree, and puts the middle of a long path behind a real button.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A short trail of links ending on the current page.

variants.name: Separators
variants.description: The three built-in dividers beside one supplied entirely by the consumer.

variants.name: Icons
variants.description: Levels carrying a leading icon, with decorative marks kept out of the reading order.

variants.name: Collapsed
variants.description: A long path with its middle behind a button, and a short one that refuses to collapse.

variants.name: Truncation
variants.description: Long labels giving way inside a narrow container while the current page stays whole.

variants.name: Sizes
variants.description: The standard and compact scales shown against the same path.
